summary: Probably John's 2nd cousin 7x removed; president of the LDS French Mission.
bio: Andrew Losee Lamoreaux (1812-1855), via Daniel Lamoureux -> Joshua (b. 1739; Loyalist; New Brunswick, then Scarborough near Toronto) -> John McCord Lamoreaux -> Andrew. President of the LDS French Mission; died of cholera at St. Louis while bringing converts west. The Utah branch descends from Joshua (1919 book).
sources: A. J. Lamoureux, André Lamoureux, the Huguenot Emigrant, and Family (The Lamoureux Record no. 1, 1919): https://archive.org/details/andrlamoureuxh00lamouoft
